title: ShinyCellModular: Modular Shiny App for Single Cell Data Exploration
text: Single-cell apps rarely stay static lab starts using : labels get reordered, axes get fixed, colours get matched figure, new tab gets requested. ’re running ShinyCell-based app one project, sound familiar: small changes usually means touching large, interconnected script. ShinyCellModular : architecture lets us keep tailoring single-cell apps individual researchers projects, quickly without waiting upstream changes. ShinyCell-derived apps one large, cross-referenced script: tabs share state call , touching one thing risks breaking another. ShinyCellModular restructures plugin system: every tab self-contained R file (UI + server + register_tab()), discovered automatically build time directory listing, hard-coded catalogue edit. Add tab dropping file; remove one without touching anything else; hand tab team member without needing understand rest app. architecture lets us keep customising ShinyCellModular researchers time, rather accumulating one-patches get harder maintain every request. build tabs , driven real project needs, module structure deliberately open: see creating modules/tabs want build adapt group.

title: ShinyCellModular: Modular Shiny App for Single Cell Data Exploration
text: ShinyCellModular R package, modular version ShinyCell developed Monash Genomics Bioinformatics Platform (MGBP). takes Seurat object single cell experiments creates interactive Shiny app explore data. module tab app, created individually self-contained. ShinyCellModular supports large scRNAseq multimodal datasets fast -demand HDF5 parquet access, extended visualisations, improved filtering, publication-ready plots. modular structure makes flexible, scalable, easy customise patch. what: Prepare a Seurat object for ShinyCellModular — prepShinyCellModular
title: Prepare a Seurat object for ShinyCellModular — prepShinyCellModular
text: Takes Seurat object single cell experiments prepares files needed run ShinyCellModular interactive Shiny app. Writes HDF5 counts, ShinyCell config files, optional 3D UMAP, marker genes, motif data out_dir.

title: Prepare a Seurat object for ShinyCellModular — prepShinyCellModular
code: prepShinyCellModular(   seurat_obj = NULL,   seurat_rds = NULL,   out_dir = "ShinyCellModular_app",   shiny_title = "ShinyCellModular Intermediate",   assays_selected = "RNA",   ident_col = NULL,   do_variable_features = TRUE,   do_markers = FALSE,   markers_file = NULL,   markers_overwrite = FALSE,   markers_res_pattern = "res\\.",   do_umap3d = FALSE,   umap3d_reductions = c("pca"),   umap3d_dims = 1:30,   umap3d_name_suffix = "_umap3d",   do_counts_h5 = TRUE,   counts_h5_file = NULL,   counts_overwrite = TRUE,   counts_layer = "counts",   do_make_app = TRUE,   gene_mapping = TRUE,   install_missing = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE,   do_motifs = "auto",   motifs_findmotifs = NULL,   motifs_overwrite = TRUE,   fragments_paths = NULL,   custom_colors = NULL,   default_genes = NULL,   help = FALSE )

title: Prepare a Seurat object for ShinyCellModular — prepShinyCellModular
text: seurat_obj Seurat object. Alternative seurat_rds. seurat_rds Path .rds Seurat object. Alternative seurat_obj. out_dir Output directory. Default: 'Files_ShinyCell'. shiny_title Title Shiny app. assays_selected Assay(s) process. e.g. c('RNA', 'ATAC'). Default: 'RNA'. ident_col Column set Idents. Default: NULL (uses existing). do_variable_features Run FindVariableFeatures creating ShinyCell config. Default: TRUE. do_markers Compute marker genes presto. Default: FALSE. markers_file Path output markers parquet file. Default: auto. markers_overwrite Overwrite existing markers file. Default: FALSE. markers_res_pattern Regex pattern find resolution columns. Default: 'res\\.'. do_umap3d Run 3D UMAP. Default: FALSE. umap3d_reductions Reductions use input 3D UMAP. Default: c('pca'). umap3d_dims Dims pass UMAP (auto-capped available). Default: 1:30. umap3d_name_suffix Suffix appended 3D UMAP reduction name. Default: '_umap3d'. do_counts_h5 Write raw counts HDF5. Default: TRUE. counts_h5_file Path output H5 file. Default: auto. counts_overwrite Overwrite existing H5 file. Default: TRUE. counts_layer Seurat layer use counts. Default: 'counts'. do_make_app Run makeShinyApp. Default: TRUE. gene_mapping Map gene names ShinyCell. Default: TRUE. install_missing Auto-install missing packages. Default: FALSE. verbose Print progress messages. Default: TRUE. do_motifs Extract motifs ATAC assay. Runs automatically ATAC assays_selected motifs slot populated. Set FALSE skip. Default: 'auto'. motifs_findmotifs Output FindMotifs(), adds enrichment scores. Default: NULL. motifs_overwrite Overwrite existing motif files. Default: TRUE. fragments_paths Optional named list fragment file path overrides index. e.g. list('1' = '/path//sample1.tsv.gz'). NULL, paths copied original paths object. Default: NULL. custom_colors Named character vector label -> hex color override ShinyCell default colors. Extra names data ignored. Default: NULL. default_genes Character vector gene names set defaults app (e.g. c('CD4', 'CD8A')). NULL, ShinyCell picks defaults. Default: NULL. help Print help message return. Default: FALSE.

what: Create a template file for a new ShinyCellModular module/tab — templateShinyCellModular
title: Create a template file for a new ShinyCellModular module/tab — templateShinyCellModular
text: Writes skeleton .R file following standard module structure (Functions / UI / Server / Registration) used across ShinyCellModular modules, new tab can built filling placeholders instead copy-pasting existing module hand.

title: Create a template file for a new ShinyCellModular module/tab — templateShinyCellModular
code: templateShinyCellModular(   id,   title,   data_type = "RNA",   multi = FALSE,   description = "TODO: describe this tab",   author = NULL,   contact = NULL,   shinycellmodular.dir.src = NULL,   overwrite = FALSE )

title: Create a template file for a new ShinyCellModular module/tab — templateShinyCellModular
text: id Tab id — used filename (sans extension) prefix generated function names (<id>_ui, <id>_server). Must unique across modules/. Required. title Human readable title shown tab. Required. data_type modules/ subfolder write : 'RNA', 'RNA_ATAC' 'SPATIAL'. Default: 'RNA'. multi Write _multi variant. _multi appended id filename, function names registered tab id, per existing multi-dataset naming convention. Default: FALSE. description Short description used register_tab(). Default: "TODO: describe tab". author Author name used register_tab(). Required. contact Contact email used register_tab(). Required. shinycellmodular.dir.src Path ShinyCellModular source directory containing modules/. Default: system.file('', package = 'ShinyCellModular'). overwrite Overwrite existing file name. Default: FALSE.

title: Create a template file for a new ShinyCellModular module/tab — templateShinyCellModular
text: Invisibly returns path new file.

what: Generate a modular ShinyCellModular Shiny app — useShinyCellModular
title: Generate a modular ShinyCellModular Shiny app — useShinyCellModular
text: Takes output files prepShinyCellModular writes ready--run app.R selected module tabs out_dir.

title: Generate a modular ShinyCellModular Shiny app — useShinyCellModular
code: useShinyCellModular(   out_dir,   shinycellmodular.dir.src = NULL,   rsconnect.deploy = FALSE,   data_type = NULL,   enabled_tabs = NULL,   overwrite_modules = FALSE,   disable_ui_server = TRUE,   app_title = NULL,   navbar_color = "#007BA7" )

title: Generate a modular ShinyCellModular Shiny app — useShinyCellModular
text: out_dir Directory containing prepared prepShinyCellModular output files (sc1conf.rds, sc1meta.rds, etc.). shinycellmodular.dir.src Path ShinyCellModular source directory containing modules/. Default: system.file('', package = 'ShinyCellModular'). rsconnect.deploy Write rsconnect manifest deployment. Default: FALSE. data_type Preset tab selection: 'RNA', 'RNA_ATAC', 'SPATIAL'. Default: 'RNA'. enabled_tabs Character vector tab IDs include. Overrides data_type presets. Default: NULL (uses tabs data_type). overwrite_modules Remove replace existing modules/ folder. Default: FALSE. disable_ui_server Rename legacy ui.R server.R .bak. Default: TRUE. app_title Title shown app navbar. Required.

title: Generate a modular ShinyCellModular Shiny app — useShinyCellModular
text: Invisibly returns NULL. Writes app.R modules/ out_dir.
